## Change and evidence

Link the change folder, ADRs and retained verification/review evidence. State the
submitted revision, commands actually run, results and remaining limitations.

## Gates

- [ ] Intent, spec and plan were accepted before implementation (or justified trivial exemptions).
- [ ] Significant decisions have ADRs; deviations are linked without rewriting accepted inputs.
- [ ] Actual verification passed on this submission; bug fixes preserve failing-test evidence.
- [ ] Independent correctness, security and compliance review resolved Important findings.
- [ ] Changelog and handoff describe the final state and remaining deployment boundaries.
- [ ] No fixture result is presented as live provider or host-isolation certification.

Production authorization and live platform control changes remain separate scope.
